question: In the context of the Indian census, what is the definition of the literacy percentage?

options.text: The percentage of people aged seven and above, who can read and write in any language
The percentage of people with a college degree
The percentage of people who can read and write in English
The percentage of people who can perform basic arithmetic calculations

solution:
The correct answer is __**option 1**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the Indian census, *l**iteracy rate***** is a measure of the proportion of people in a population who have basic reading and writing skills in any language.**
 
• This definition does not require fluency or advanced literacy skills but simply the ability to read and write with comprehension.
 
• T**he literacy rate considers individuals aged seven years and above.**
 
• This age threshold is set because, by this age, most children have started schooling and are expected to acquire basic reading and writing skills
 
• Literacy does not imply having a college degree or advanced education
 
• **It simply means the ability to read and write with understanding.**
 
• The l**iteracy rate counts people who can read and write in any language, not necessarily English or Hindi.**
 
• This inclusivity is important in a multilingual country like India.
